about: How many rows of the grid a window holds at its height (docs/ledger/app-mcp.md, 2026-11-13): its height less its padding above and below and the frame's bars (each of the window's own, else the app's), divided into rows with the gaps between them. A menu bar, a toolbar, a ribbon (its tabs, and its body unless it is folded or has no tab), and a footer (its status line, or a row and a little when it holds parts). Clarity.UI draws the bars at these heights; the checker refuses a window whose parts reach a row it does not hold, and a slide-out taller than that.

cases.name: a toolbar, as the maintenance app's main window
a menu bar and a toolbar
an open ribbon and a status line, at a lower row height
a footer with parts, filled to the last pixel
